convention.note: Every published item has a sibling index.json and index.md next to its page: /item/<slug>/index.json and /item/<slug>/index.md in Korean, /en/item/<slug>/index.json and /en/item/<slug>/index.md in English. Keys name the unit (stars, star_delta_7d, hf_likes); every figure sits next to its reference time (as_of, *_at); null means not observed, never zero. Counts are stored observations, not scores. These files are not in the sitemap.
